Priya R.: Hi folks  need to add my niece to benefits. She's moving from abroad and I have a sponsor letter + temporary guardianship letter. Passport and SSN still pending. Can I start enrollment?
Sam (People Ops): You can submit a QLE now. For international-to-US placements we typically need: guardianship/sponsor letter, proof of shared residence (lease, school registration, or landlord attestation), birth certificate, and any immigration receipts. Passport/SSN can be added later.
Priya R.: Sponsor letter is from my sister and notarized by their local notary. Do you need an embassy attestation too?
Jordan (Benefits): Embassy attestation helps but isn't required in every case. If you have notarized sponsor/guardian docs plus a school enrollment email or proof of address, we can mark the dependent "provisionally enrolled" pending passport/SSN.
Priya R.: If provisionally enrolled, will premiums show up immediately on my paystub?
Jordan (Benefits): Premiums will begin as of the QLE effective date (usually placement date). Payroll will post retro adjustments if any backdating is required. PayrollBot will flag adjustments once People Ops approves.
Priya R.: Is there any limit on how long "provisional" can stay open while waiting for SSN? I can't get SSN until visa interview, might be several months.
Sam (People Ops): We usually give a provisional window of up to 90 days for SSN/passport collection; exceptions possible for documented immigration delays. After 90 days we ask for status updates. If you can't secure SSN within that timeframe, we'll coordinate with Benefits to decide next steps.
Priya R.: Do we need to redact the child's SSN on documents? I might upload a translated birth cert that shows no SSN yet.
Jordan (Benefits): If a document contains an SSN, please blackout it before upload. If none exists yet, that's fine. For translations, include original plus certified English translation.
Priya R.: Where do I upload? I recall some folks had issues with file size. Also want to make sure the files stay secure.
Sam (People Ops): Use the benefits portal -> Manage Dependents -> Add Dependent (QLE). For very large scanned packets (over 20MB) use the secure SFTP option listed on the portal page and note the filename in the portal submission. Filename convention we prefer: lastname-firstname-documenttype (e.g., patel-ava-guardian.pdf). That speeds up triage.
Priya R.: Great. Also, will adding this dependent affect my ability to claim them as a tax dependent? Are benefits enrollment and tax dependent status linked?
Jordan (Benefits): Enrollment in benefits is separate from IRS tax dependent status. However, if you're claiming FSA dependent care, the IRS rules for eligible dependents apply. If tax status matters for your personal filings you should consult a tax advisor. We can confirm plan-specific implications after enrollment.
Priya R.: One more edge case: sponsor letter says "temporary guardianship until school age"  does that create any eligibility risk later?
Sam (People Ops): If guardianship ends or the dependent no longer lives with you, that can trigger a loss-of-eligibility QLE and potential COBRA events for that dependent. Keep documentation of any status changes and let People Ops know ASAP.
Priya R.: Understood. How long does the review take?
Jordan (Benefits): Standard review is 3 business days after complete submission. If you request an exception or escalation for visa delays it'll be 5-7 business days. We'll post updates in-thread.
PayrollBot: Payroll flag queued: retro-adjustment pending People Ops approval. Ticket ID: BF-5579.
Priya R.: Uploading now: patel-ava-guardian.pdf, patel-ava-birthcert.pdf, patel-ava-school-email.pdf. Thanks y'all :pray:
Sam (People Ops): Thanks Priya  we'll review and follow up. If you want to DM me the SFTP receipt once uploaded I can expedite the ticket. :thumbsup:
